item.text: I’ve got the main 2B shape: Indonesia is not a belligerent in 2022, so the chapter turns on Jokowi’s actual international-security conduct, especially Ukraine/G20 diplomacy and multilateral peace messaging. I’m now collecting a compact set of primary and independent sources that show what he did in 2022, not just the country posture.
